ACADEMIC IDENTITY

A polished medical-learning gateway with a clear institutional character.

NABD Academy is designed to feel like a refined university-style portal while remaining clear about its role: a digital educational platform focused on theoretical medical learning, structured presentation, and transparent completion records.

Structured Study Paths

Each program is presented as a pathway with clear modules, helping learners see what comes first and what comes next.

Medical Visual Language

Course cards use medical-inspired visuals such as skeletal forms, tissue patterns, DNA concepts and physiology motifs.

Verification by Code or Name

The verification gateway allows search by certificate ID and also by learner name, with original certificate preview and QR.

Transparent Scope

Completion certificates are shown responsibly and clearly separated from university degrees or professional licences.

CERTIFICATE VERIFICATION GATEWAY

Search by certificate ID or student name

Enter a certificate code such as NABD-MT-2026-0001, or type a student name. The system displays the official record, the printed QR crop, and the original certificate image stored within the page.

OFFICIAL RECORD LOOKUP

Verification portal

Search by ID or name. Example IDs: NABD-MT-2026-0001 to NABD-MT-2026-0049.

Supports both certificate code and learner name.

Official certificate preview

After a successful search, the matching certificate image will appear here together with record data and QR.
PUBLIC REGISTRY

Certificate registry

Fast lookup across the published completion records. Click any row to send it directly to the verification portal.
